newsitem.title: USA: PSC sees Q1 EPS at $0.06-$0.08.
newsitem.headline: PSC sees Q1 EPS at $0.06-$0.08.

text.p: PSC Inc said Monday it expected first quarter revenues of $54 million and earnings per share of $0.06-$0.08, which would meet or exceed analysts' expectations.
Analysts consensus earnings estimate is $0.07 a share, according to First Call. The estimate is based on forecasts made by three analysts, which ranged from $0.06 a share to $0.07, it said.
Last year, the company reported a profit of $0.04 a share for the same period.

PSC said it had formed a special committee to study how to improve its market value. "(It) will work with management to conduct an intensive review of the company's strategic direction, organizational structure and operations in an effort to enhance shareholder value," it said. "This review is expected to be completed within the next several weeks."
The company, which makes bar code scanners, said it would release results for the first quarter, ended April 4, on April 28.
